name: Solid East African Olivewood
description: Hard, marbled grain seasoned for 18 months in shade. Naturally antimicrobial with high density and striking contrasting heartwood.

name: Smoked Red Cedar & White Oak
description: Slow-charred surface conditioning, wire-buffed to raise the tactile grain, and sealed with organic beeswax and cold-pressed citrus oil.

name: Hand-Silvered Mirror & Fluted Glass
description: Crafted in our glass atelier using chemical silver precipitation for soft, depth-rich reflection without harsh sterile glare.

name: Vegetable-Tanned Full Grain Leather
description: Sourced from Rift Valley herds, tanned naturally with indigenous wattle bark extracts. Retains all natural grain nuances and patinas over decades.

name: Unlacquered Cast Bronze
description: Poured in small foundry batches, finished with handheld scrapers. Left completely untreated so everyday touches deepen its golden, living patina.
